column1: # Adjudication of the 2026-08-06 capture-pipeline candidate export.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The candidates carry a `theme_suggestion` from
# demand_signal_core.suggest_theme, a keyword matcher calibrated on curated
# proposal requirement-matrix rows. The capture pipeline does not feed those.
# It feeds Quick Vet's `key_requirements`, which is mixed prose: real customer
# asks alongside submission mechanics, eligibility rules, and Quick Vet's own
# inferences about an opportunity it could not read. On this export the matcher
# themed 149 of 454, and a large share of those are false — "Physical
# infrastructure modernization projects at JBLM including barracks replacement"
# was themed `cross-domain-model-update`, and "Supply 3x NI-9244 Voltage Input
# Modules" was themed `platform-integration-embedded`. Promoting the matcher's
# output unreviewed would have inflated `ato-accreditation-artifacts` with
# language, and the theme leaderboard is the register's entire product.
# So every row is adjudicated by hand and the adjudication is committed, which
# is the only form in which it can be argued with.
#   signal <theme>   a customer asking for a capability, mapped to a theme in
#   hold <slug>      a real ask the controlled vocabulary has no home for. NOT
#                    promoted. The slug is a proposed theme; adding it is a
#                    deliberate edit to capability-themes.md, per that file.
#   drop mechanics   how to submit: deadlines, page limits, templates, portals,
#                    award instruments, phases, CDRLs, proposal instructions
#   drop posture     who may bid: eligibility, ownership, clearances, FCL,
#                    set-asides, cost share, registrations, personnel quals.
#   drop speculation Quick Vet inferring rather than the customer speaking —
#                    admission that the source had no content. The register is
#                    verbatim customer language; an inference is not one.
#   drop off-domain  a genuine ask outside the capability space this register
#                    serves — hardware supply, machining, construction, CAD
#                    seats, cadet training logistics, organoids, vacuum packages
#   drop too-generic a real ask stated at a grain no theme can carry ("AI/ML"
#                    as an area of interest). Counting it would add weight
#   drop stale-closed a prior AOI the notice itself marks closed. Ingesting it
#                    would date it to the vet, not to when it was open.
